text: Calthorpe Part 2 done - 47 min. Capex per bird NZ$45-65 depending on existing infrastructure, DOC supply waitlists 6-9 months from major NZ + AU breeders, 12-18 month build cycle once consents are in hand. Free-range premium currently 18-22% in transaction prices, not the 30%+ broker is quoting. Customer concentration: 'their top retail relationships are heavy on Foodstuffs and Woolworths NZ - wouldn't surprise me if those two are 60-70% of revenue.'
There's the customer concentration anchor. 60-70% top-2/3 is enormous risk.
And the 12-18mo build cycle plus 6-9mo DOC waitlist is your bridge math. If they haven't started consents already, end-2027 isn't happening.
Calthorpe Part 3 booked Monday. Will close the loop on top-down vs bottom-up reconciliation + final timeline view + bottom-line opportunities.
Perfect. Wednesday checkpoint moves to Friday morning given the Part 3 timing.
